name: functions
description: Cloud Functions for Cam_hubs — detection push notification fan-out (006)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && node --test --import tsx test/clips.test.ts test/subscription.test.ts test/notification.test.ts test/sweepStaleSessions.test.ts test/reapExpiredClips.test.ts test/iceServers.test.ts
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project cam-hubs-rules-test --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --import tsx test/rules.subscription.test.ts test/rules.access.test.ts test/rules.talkLinks.test.ts"
scripts.test:functions: GCLOUD_PROJECT=cam-hubs-fn-test firebase emulators:exec --project cam-hubs-fn-test --only firestore "node --test --import tsx test/authorizeDetection.test.ts test/webhook.test.ts test/pairing.test.ts test/getIceServers.test.ts"
